reasoning: In a landmark 2023 study ("GPT-4 Passes the Bar Exam" by Bommarito & Katz), researchers demonstrated that OpenAI's GPT-4 passed the Uniform Bar Exam (UBE) with an estimated score of 297. This score is significantly higher than the minimum passing threshold in all UBE jurisdictions (which ranges from 260 to 270). While some subsequent academic critiques argued that the "90th percentile" claim originally made by OpenAI was slightly overstated—suggesting GPT-4 actually scored closer to the 68th percentile when compared to the full pool of real-world test-takers who pass the exam—either metric is comfortably above the 50th percentile. Thus, it is well-established that AI language models can now pass the US bar exam with above-average scores.
